description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by paying {U}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Malcolm and Niv-Mizzet trigger.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, allowing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Malcolm trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.
